name: appnigma-sample-app
description: A sample SaaS product that gives its customers integrations through the Appnigma SDK

scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
